description: OpenIrri is a web application for solid-set sprinkler irrigation design, renamed from PyIrri. This release documents tests, EPANET comparisons and continuous-integration work alongside a SoftwareX paper. The metadata is published or maintained by El-Naggar, A.G. (provider deposit/publication). It describes a generic modelling method or tool. Its domain, time horizon and numerical resolution depend on the configuration; worldwide validation is not established. The provider page supplies a documented method or software entry point; package availability and execution requirements were not independently tested. Licence: MIT. The inspected public record or source repository is free to read; this does not grant rights beyond its stated licence. Caveats: Independent reuse and ongoing maintenance were not established; admission depends on the open single-study rule. For infrastructure simulation, its documented contents can support capacity planning. These are catalogue-use assessments, not additional validation claims. The provider describes EPANET. Related catalogue records are model-epanet.
